name: GoGoPizzaBoy!
source:
"GoGoPizzaBoy!" is an NSFW, Sandbox Visual Novel where you play as a young delivery boy who has just moved to a new city.

The owner of the Pizzeria is an attractive MILF who is offering you room and board in her resort to help you out.

What could go wrong?

Crazy scientists, hot girls, and lots of pizza await you in this adventure!

[From [url=https://spicy-well-studio.itch.io/gogopizzaboy]itch.io[/url]]
